ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) surface with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters occupying approximately 5-8% of the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment field across both lobes. Numerous high-contrast circular blobs (diameters 3-15 pixels) and irregular mottling are distributed across the 2D surface, with the highest density of light-intensity pixels clustered toward the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 145-155 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel depth) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, creating a jagged micro-contour from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep, tapering to sharply defined, upturned points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (annular scars) located primarily at the distal edges and tips; scattered individual rosette marks are visible across the central and proximal lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white streaks, 10-50 pixels in length) are visible on the left lobe and the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting circular scarring at the distal tips; active calcified barnacle clusters are visible on the extreme lateral boundaries, distorting the edge silhouette.
